mistake_reason: The Assistant prematurely finalized and terminated the task with the category "Breads and Cereals" before the full uniqueness scan completed and before confirming which single food in the spreadsheet had zero alternate-name references. This early termination (FM-3.1) caused the team to miss that the genuinely unique food mapped to the "Soups and Stews" category, leading to an incorrect outcome.
